amendment.no_reuse: Do not import R3 commits/locks; any already collected R3 results remain a separate study.
amendment.reason: Pre-outcome engineering calibration exposed weak-tail estimator sensitivity and cancellation of even finite responses. Freeze one subspace iteration, unchanged continuation, per-sign gates and endpoint evidence before new research.
amendment.scope: Task-local recent-history control at the frozen checkpoint, displacement and h=16 in clean synthetic ResNet18-GN/AdamW; no universal basis, full optimizer-state compression or architecture/natural-data generalization claim.

parent_evidence.NEXUS_I: Stage1A negative; Stage1B d=1 geometry without predictive state; Stage1C promising pressure pilot; Stage2P/Q support preflights passed; architecture confirmation was attempted and stopped at ViT competency (optimistic median upper 0.612 < 0.65).
parent_evidence.NEXUS_II_RC11: Pressure-induced emergence failed; clean eta=0 exhibited stable low-dimensional predictive structure and approximate closure.
parent_evidence.NEXUS_II_STAGE05: RC12D H5 failed: F/I/Q/N/P/S passed while G/Z/E/C failed.

NEXUS_II_STAGE06.frozen_result: H6-B=false, H6-W=false, H6-A=true. Within-task matched-query r=0.7765 [0.700,0.845], but causal future prediction lost to zero. Historical m1 potency was 90.93x median random and 70.79x best-of-eight random.

parent_evidence.policy: Design history only. No Stage01-06 response row, fitted coordinate, decoder, subspace, or confirmation outcome enters Stage07 estimation.

prereg.cohort_independence: Discovery locks task-identity hashes only (not outcomes). Confirmation must have unique task hashes and zero overlap with frozen discovery task hashes before claims are evaluated.
prereg.confirmation_firewall: Confirmation notebook may read only the cryptographically frozen discovery lock (selected rank, protocol/code/environment identities and preregistered selection diagnostics), never discovery raw response vectors when fitting confirmation quantities.

headline_claims.H7_A: History alignment/privilege: the historical recipient-minus-donor exp_avg direction aligns with and is more potent in the high-gain subspace than tensor-norm-matched random, sign-shuffled, and within-tensor-permuted controls. Current-gradient and preconditioned-gradient directions are frozen mechanistic comparators reported separately.
headline_claims.H7_C: Finite causal sufficiency: at the identical m1 surgery scale, P_U h preserves most h=16 functional effect while (I-P_U)h contributes little. The original paired-response gates AND the same retention/cosine/remainder/additivity gates for EACH signed effect relative to an unchanged-optimizer continuation must all pass. All seven endpoint branches use identical snapshots, batches and RNG. No even-response component is assumed negligible.
headline_claims.H7_F: Fresh-system foundation: the frozen clean-learning population remains competent and every confirmation finite history surgery is local and function-preserving, with nontrivial one-step and h=16 full effects. The paired and both baseline-relative signed full effects must each have RMSE at least 2e-5 in research mode.
headline_claims.H7_L: Transferred low-rank control: a discovery-frozen rank k<=8 captures most Frobenius control energy on an independent output anchor, not merely the anchor used to estimate the subspace.

prereg.no_rescue: No post-confirmation threshold, rank, control panel, cohort, timepoint, or endpoint changes are permitted.
prereg.operator: J_t maps an infinitesimal perturbation of AdamW exp_avg at fixed model parameters to centered logits after one common next AdamW update. The right control subspace is estimated on a calibration anchor without using historical m1, with one normalized and reorthogonalized J^T J subspace iteration and relative basis tolerance 1e-6; rank capture is selected and confirmed on an independent evaluation anchor under the same physical update.
prereg.rank_selection: On discovery only, choose the smallest candidate k whose mean independent-anchor control-energy capture is >=0.80 and bootstrap 95% lower bound >=0.70. If none qualifies, freeze the largest candidate and mark discovery low-rank prequalification false; confirmation still runs unchanged.
prereg.scientific_question: Does clean neural learning organize hidden AdamW first-moment memory into a genuinely low-rank, high-gain causal-control geometry that is distinct from predictive low-dimensional summaries?
prereg.strong_claim: H7_M = H7_F AND H7_L AND H7_A AND H7_C. Temporal measurements and gradient/preconditioned-gradient comparators are reported separately and cannot rescue H7_M.
